## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md — Licensing (DCO))
- [ ] A user-visible change has an entry under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] A breaking change or a manual upgrade step is described in UPGRADING.md
- [ ] Docs updated (in-app guide, user-guide/, docs/operations/) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, private host names, local paths or real data in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] New dependencies are under a license on `scripts/license-allowlist.json`
